events.name: Plague

choices.label: Quarantine
choices.effect: -10 morale now; population losses halved and the plague ends next turn.

choices.label: Emergency cure
choices.effect: Pay 150 credits (60 in prototype rules) to end the plague at once; quarantine if unaffordable.

choices.label: Let it run its course
choices.effect: No cost; the colony loses population every turn for four turns.

events.description: A plague broke out at {where}. Each turn it kills {magnitude}% of the colonists (Biotech research lowers the rate) until turn {endTurn}.

events.name: Supernova warning

choices.label: Evacuate
choices.effect: Move half the colonists to the nearest colonies with room before the star explodes.

choices.label: Stellar shielding
choices.effect: Pay 400 credits (150 in prototype rules) to limit losses to 30%; evacuate if unaffordable.

choices.label: Trust the scientists
choices.effect: No action; the detonation kills 75% of the colony and -25 morale.

events.description: Astronomers predict the star of {where} will explode on turn {endTurn}, killing {magnitude}% of its colonists and crippling ships in the sector.

events.name: Subspace rift
events.description: A subspace rift opened at {where}. The sector is impassable until turn {endTurn}; scouts that study it gain Computers research.

events.name: Trade boom
events.description: Interstellar commerce is booming: +{magnitude} credits per colony each turn (at most 150) until turn {endTurn}.

events.name: Derelict vessel

choices.label: Salvage its technology
choices.effect: Research equal to 40% of the next level in our weakest field.

choices.label: Study its sensor logs
choices.effect: +60 intelligence and charts the surrounding sectors.

events.description: Our crews found a derelict vessel of unknown origin at {where}.

events.name: Labor unrest

choices.label: Meet their demands
choices.effect: Pay 20 + population credits for +15 morale; martial law if unaffordable.

choices.label: Ignore the strike
choices.effect: -5 morale and 20 lost construction work every turn until it fades.

events.description: Workers at {where} went on strike over low morale. Until resolved the colony loses morale and construction work.

events.name: Scientific breakthrough

choices.label: Theoretical focus
choices.effect: Research equal to 50% of the next level in our weakest field.

choices.label: Applied engineering
choices.effect: Research equal to 50% of the next Construction level.

choices.label: Weapons research
choices.effect: Research equal to 50% of the next Weapons level.

events.description: Our scientists made an unexpected breakthrough and ask where to apply it.
